title: Return pairs
statementMd:
Find city pairs that have flights in both directions. List each pair once as (origin, destination) with origin alphabetically smaller.

Expected columns: `city_a`, `city_b`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Self-join flights where origin/destination are swapped; use `DISTINCT`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT a.origin AS city_a, a.destination AS city_b FROM flights a JOIN flights b ON a.origin = b.destination AND a.destination = b.origin WHERE a.origin < a.destination;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
